stories.title: Define Travel Burden Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define structured response schema for travel including origin_type (user_zip|lat_lng), destination (site address/lat_lng), distance_miles, duration_minutes, route_status, and error_code for missing or failed route data.

stories.title: Implement Travel Distance and Time Computation Logic
stories.description: Implement backend logic using Google Routes API to compute travel distance and duration between user location and each clinical trial site, including unit normalization, timeout handling, and deterministic fallback (null metrics with route_status=UNAVAILABLE) for failed API responses.

stories.title: Integrate Travel Burden into Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Expose computed travel distance and duration through evaluate_care_facade and ensure response contract compatibility with tool_router and clinical_trials_models, attaching travel metrics to each trial location for downstream chat/UI consumption.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Travel Burden Computation
stories.description: Create unit tests for travel computation logic including edge cases (invalid locations, API failures, timeouts) and integration tests validating end-to-end flow from facade to service with mocked Google Routes responses.

stories.title: Optimize Google Routes API Usage for Multi-Location Trials
stories.description: Implement batching or sequential optimization for multiple trial locations, including rate-limit backoff and lightweight TTL caching (per origin-destination pair) to stabilize performance and reduce redundant Google Routes API calls.
